statement: For finite-dimensional N, fixed finite R, and a >= 1, the Gibbs exponential supremum equals the entropy-functional supremum. A violating faithful X yields the positive Gibbs input Y=exp(G_X)/Phi(X), and a violating input yields X=N(rho) with at least that objective.
